title: Audit your app stack
inputs: App names, bills, used features and connected systems
prompt: Map each supplied Shopify app to the functions we actually use. Separate storefront display, admin work, automation and external integrations. Identify overlapping features and missing dependency information. Recommend what to investigate before keeping, replacing or removing each app. Do not recommend uninstalling anything yet.
review: Compare the table with app settings and ask the people using each workflow.

title: Compare build versus buy
inputs: Subscription cost, build estimate, maintenance hours and hourly cost
prompt: Compare keeping this app with building the limited replacement described here. Calculate twelve-month cash costs and show labor separately. Include hosting, maintenance, support and update assumptions. Identify which unknown could reverse the decision. Do not invent a savings figure.
review: Recalculate the arithmetic and distinguish hypothetical inputs from actual quotes.

title: Write a narrow app brief
inputs: One merchant problem and three representative examples
prompt: Turn this merchant problem into a one-page app specification. Define its user, data inputs, visible output, read or write actions, exclusions, failure states and acceptance cases. Recommend the appropriate Shopify surface. Ask about missing requirements before proposing implementation.
review: Make sure the specification excludes unrelated features and names the platform surface.

title: Build a catalog QA admin app
inputs: Product statuses to include and the definition of missing data
prompt: Generate a read-only Shopify admin app listing products without a meaningful description or product image. Show title, status and missing fields, with a way to review the product. Handle pagination, loading, failures and an empty result. Do not modify products or send data externally. Explain unsupported requirements and permissions before installation.
output: An app draft and permission explanation
review: Compare known complete and incomplete records, including one beyond the first results page.

title: Draft a team task tracker
inputs: Task fields, team workflow and storage requirements
prompt: Plan a simple Shopify admin task tracker for our internal team. We need task title, owner, due date and status. First explain whether the required storage and team behavior are supported in this environment. Flag unsupported features. Do not use customer records as task storage or request unrelated permissions. Build only after the plan is reviewed.
output: A feasibility plan, then a scoped app draft
review: Verify persistence, staff access and required fields; do not assume a visible list is durable storage.

title: Plan a reorder review dashboard
inputs: Date range, inventory locations and supplier lead times
prompt: Plan a read-only reorder review dashboard using supported store data. Explain the sales period, stock measure and proposed calculation. Identify missing supplier lead times and stock adjustments. Show assumptions beside results. Do not create purchase orders or change inventory. Flag unsupported data before building.
output: A dashboard plan with data gaps
review: Check calculations on known products and handle returns, stockouts and location differences.

title: Find missing app requirements
inputs: App specification and relevant repository files
prompt: Review this specification against the current Shopify documentation and this repository. List missing API fields, permissions, persistence requirements and failure behavior. Separate supported implementation paths from assumptions. Do not modify files or run store mutations during this review.
output: A gap list with source references
review: Open the cited documentation and resolve blocking questions before implementation.

title: Write acceptance cases
inputs: Feature brief and sample records
prompt: Create acceptance cases for this feature: normal use, empty data, invalid inputs, permission failure and partial network failure. State expected output and evidence for each case. Use supplied fixtures rather than private customer data. Do not claim tests have run.
review: Ensure cases test the desired behavior rather than merely repeat implementation details.

title: Review requested permissions
inputs: Manifest, routes and feature list
prompt: Compare the requested Shopify permissions with the code paths and feature requirements provided. Explain each scope and identify unused or excessive access. Distinguish read from write access. Do not remove a scope automatically; list the impact and a verification step.
review: Confirm every required action remains possible and no secret is included in the report.

title: Prepare a rollback plan
inputs: Deployment method, changed files and data changes
prompt: Write a rollback plan for this change. Separate code rollback from data recovery. Identify backups, compatibility concerns, the person who can stop rollout and the evidence needed to resume. Do not assume reverting code reverses stored data changes.
review: Verify that recovery steps exist in the actual environment before deployment.

title: Draft a size-chart section
inputs: Unpublished theme, size table, product mapping and units
prompt: In the unpublished theme copy, propose a size-chart section using the supplied measurements and units. Inspect existing theme patterns first. Include accessible headings and mobile behavior. Keep chart assignment explicit per product. Do not publish the theme or invent measurements. Explain how the merchant edits the data.
output: A theme change proposal or draft
review: Review different products, long labels, keyboard access and narrow screens before publishing.

title: Draft an announcement bar
inputs: Unpublished theme, approved text and destination
prompt: Inspect this theme for an existing announcement setting before adding code. If a new section is needed, build a simple text-and-link announcement bar in the unpublished copy using existing conventions. Include editor settings and readable mobile styling. Do not add tracking, timers or fabricated urgency. Do not publish.
output: A native-setting recommendation or small section draft
review: Check the destination, contrast, keyboard access and behavior when the text is empty.

title: Write product copy from facts
inputs: Approved specifications and brand voice
prompt: Draft a concise product description using only these supplied facts. Separate included items from optional accessories. Preserve dimensions, materials and compatibility exactly. List unanswered buying questions separately. Do not add certifications, performance claims or delivery promises. Return a draft without publishing.
review: Compare every claim, quantity and unit with the supplied specifications.

title: Draft product FAQs
inputs: Real questions, approved product facts and policies
prompt: Turn these real customer questions into a short product FAQ. Answer only from the supplied facts and current policies. Mark unanswerable questions for review. Avoid repeating the description and do not invent guarantees. Return draft text only.
review: Check policy dates and ensure each answer resolves the actual question.

title: Build a product comparison
inputs: Product fact sheets and comparison criteria
prompt: Compare these products using the supplied facts and criteria. Use the same units, mark unavailable information and keep opinion separate from fact. Do not pick a winner without a stated customer need. Return a table and the questions a buyer should resolve.
review: Verify source facts and avoid treating missing information as a negative product feature.

title: Describe product images
inputs: Product images and their page context
prompt: Draft concise alt text for each supplied image based on what is visible and its purpose on the page. Distinguish product color or angle where useful. Do not infer material, certification or included accessories from appearance alone. Flag decorative images for human review.
review: Inspect each image and avoid unnecessary repetition or keyword stuffing.

title: Plan collection merchandising
inputs: Collection goal, product data and constraints
prompt: Propose a collection merchandising brief for this goal using the supplied products. Explain grouping, ordering and exclusions. Identify stock or seasonality assumptions and distinguish recommendations from verified facts. Do not move or publish products.
review: Review available stock, customer intent and business constraints before applying changes.

title: Review mobile shopping
inputs: Preview URL and target device widths
prompt: Review this preview as a mobile shopper. Inspect product options, price visibility, purchase controls, images and navigation at the supplied widths. Report observable issues with evidence and reproduction steps. Do not place orders or change the site. Distinguish screenshots from interactions actually tested.
review: Reproduce findings and prioritize blockers over cosmetic preferences.

title: Check a discount brief
inputs: Eligibility, combinations, dates, currency and examples
prompt: Review this proposed discount specification for ambiguity. Work through the supplied carts, eligible products, combination rules and date boundaries. List expected outcomes and missing facts. Do not create a discount or assume the platform supports an unstated rule.
review: Validate supported rules in Shopify and confirm totals before activation.

title: Explain a store report
inputs: Authorized report, date range and metric definitions
prompt: Analyze this report using its stated date range and metric definitions. Separate traffic, orders, revenue, refunds and contribution where available. Identify missing denominators and reporting delays. Show calculations, distinguish correlation from causation, and suggest one useful next investigation.
review: Check totals, time zones, comparison periods and whether revenue is gross or net.

title: Format approved size chart measurements
inputs: Approved measurements, units and definitions
prompt: Format these approved garment measurements into an accessible HTML table for a Shopify page: [measurements]. Preserve every number, unit, size label and measurement definition exactly. Include a caption explaining whether these are body or garment measurements. Flag missing or contradictory values. Do not estimate sizes, add fit recommendations, or convert units unless I supply an approved conversion rule. Return the table and a list of unresolved questions.
output: An accessible chart and unresolved questions
review: Compare every number and unit with the approved source.

title: Map products to size chart pages
inputs: Product handles and approved chart page handles
prompt: Given this product-handle list and these approved chart page handles, propose a product-to-chart mapping. Explain each rule. Flag ambiguous products and products that should have no chart. Keep adult, child and different garment cuts separate. Output a review table only; do not update Shopify or infer measurements.
review: Check every ambiguous product and a sample from each rule.

title: Replace a basic Kiwi chart display
inputs: Unpublished theme and page-reference metafield definition
prompt: Inspect this unpublished Shopify theme and its product template. We need a size-chart link sourced from a product page-reference metafield. Prefer the existing compatible pop-up block. If custom code is necessary, propose the smallest change, hide the link when no page is assigned, preserve keyboard focus behavior, and keep the table usable on narrow screens. Show the files, preview steps and rollback instructions. Do not publish, alter product data, or call an external service.
review: Check blank fields, product mapping, mobile tables and keyboard focus.

title: Configure a native announcement bar
inputs: Approved message, existing URL and unpublished theme
prompt: In this unpublished theme, check whether the built-in announcement bar supports a text message and link. If it does, prepare the message “[approved message]” linking to [existing policy URL]. Preserve the approved qualification and do not change shipping rules, discounts or checkout settings. Show me the proposed change and preview. Do not publish the theme. If the feature is unavailable, explain the limitation instead of claiming it is configured.
output: A supported native configuration or a limitation report
review: Check the actual edited theme, message and destination before saving.

title: Replace a simple Hextom bar display
inputs: Unpublished theme and display requirements
prompt: Inspect this Shopify theme. Propose an editable announcement section with one text field and one optional link, using existing theme styles. Keep it static, accessible by keyboard, and readable at 320px width and 200% zoom. Prevent it from covering navigation or content. Do not add tracking, geolocation, countdowns, external scripts or automatic discount logic. Show the minimal file changes, preview steps and rollback. Work only on the unpublished copy.
review: Test navigation, keyboard access, narrow screens and zoom.

title: Review an announcement against store rules
inputs: Approved shipping or promotion rules and banner text
prompt: Review this banner text against these approved shipping and promotion rules: [rules]. Identify missing regions, thresholds, exclusions or end dates. Suggest the shortest accurate message and an existing destination link. Do not invent urgency, extend an offer or change its terms. List what must be verified at checkout.
output: Accurate message options and checkout checks
review: Confirm thresholds, regions and dates against actual settings.

title: Map Tabs Studio content before replacement
inputs: Visible tabs and approved source inventory
prompt: Review these product tabs and approved content sources: [inventory]. Classify each as shared policy, product-specific text, conditional content, or another app’s output. Propose a content map for a Shopify theme. Flag missing source text and conflicting rules. Do not rewrite policy terms, infer care instructions, copy reviews, or change product records. Return a mapping table for review.
output: A content ownership and destination map
review: Check policy ownership, product differences and review integrations.

title: Check native product accordion support
inputs: Unpublished theme and proposed field mapping
prompt: Inspect this unpublished Shopify theme and the proposed content map. Determine whether its existing collapsible rows can connect to compatible product metafields. Identify exact settings and field types from the theme and current documentation. Do not assume every block accepts every metafield type. Explain how blank values and shared content will behave. Prefer configuration over code and do not publish or change shared product data.
review: Verify compatible field types and behavior with blank values.

title: Build a limited product accordion
inputs: Approved field mapping and unpublished theme
prompt: In this unpublished theme, build the smallest product accordion for the approved field mapping. Render product-specific content from the current product, keep shared policy links separate, and omit optional rows with no content. Use semantic details/summary where suitable, visible focus styles and existing theme typography. Preserve rich text safely through Shopify’s supported rendering. Do not duplicate the full product description, recreate review integrations, or add external scripts. Provide file changes, preview checks and rollback instructions. Do not publish.
review: Test different products, empty fields, keyboard use and preserved content.

title: Calculate net app replacement savings
inputs: Actual bill, billing interval, build hours, labor value, maintenance and added tools
prompt: Calculate gross avoided subscription costs separately from first-year net benefit. Use my actual billing interval, renewal date, taxes and prepaid commitments; do not assume an immediate refund. Subtract setup labor, recurring maintenance and additional tool or hosting costs. Show every assumption, formula and a higher-effort scenario. Mark hypothetical inputs and ask for missing figures.
review: Recalculate totals and confirm cancellation and renewal terms.

title: Compare a free app plan before building
inputs: Current app features used, official free-plan limits and theme capabilities
prompt: Compare these required functions with the supplied official free-plan limits and native theme capabilities. Identify what would be lost by downgrading. Recommend the simplest option that meets the requirements, including keeping the paid plan if needed. Do not assume a free plan has identical features or invent current pricing.
output: A keep, downgrade or build comparison
review: Verify current pricing and whether the feature limits fit the whole catalog.

title: Inventory app-owned content
inputs: App settings, exports, fields and documented integrations
prompt: List content and data owned by this app versus Shopify or another provider. Identify what may disappear or stop updating after removal. Propose a preservation and mapping checklist. Flag exports we do not have. Do not copy proprietary code, scrape other stores or uninstall anything.
review: Confirm exports can be read and all required records are represented.

title: Review an app replacement before launch
inputs: Original used functions and candidate replacement
prompt: Create acceptance checks comparing the original used functions with this replacement. Include different products, blank optional fields, mobile widths, keyboard navigation and existing integrations. State the evidence needed for each check. Mark all checks not yet run; do not infer success from screenshots.
review: Execute the checks in preview and record actual failures and passes.

title: Document a theme replacement for future updates
inputs: Approved change files, field definitions and preview results
prompt: Write a short maintenance handoff for this theme customization. Name changed files, data sources, owner, edit steps, known limits, checks after theme updates and rollback steps. Distinguish reverting theme files from restoring shared product data. Do not claim a theme duplicate backs up the entire store.
review: Have the future owner follow the instructions in a safe preview.

title: Verify an app cancellation outcome
inputs: Subscription terms, renewal date and non-sensitive billing records
prompt: Create a checklist to verify that this app replacement actually reduces the bill. Separate disabling a widget, uninstalling an app, canceling an externally billed subscription and any prepaid commitment. Identify which records prove the change. Do not claim cancellation or refunds have occurred.
review: Check the app provider and Shopify billing records after the relevant billing cycle.

title: Plan one order-tagging rule
inputs: Exact rule, tag spelling, downstream consumers and plan
prompt: Draft a Flow plan for [event and condition] adding [exact tag]. Do not change fulfillment, inventory or existing tags. Identify editor fields I must verify. Include matching, nonmatching and missing-data cases. List downstream dependencies and exclude historical backfill unless separately specified. Do not claim installation or test success.
output: A bounded configuration plan and cases
review: Confirm fields in Flow and inspect final tags after other processes run.

title: Stress-test replacement economics
inputs: Actual billing interval, avoidable charges, setup estimate and maintenance range
prompt: Compare [app] with replacing only [function] over [period]. Separate cash charges and owner labor. Calculate break-even only when recurring savings are positive. Double maintenance in a second scenario. Account for retained features that prevent cancellation. Keep 30-day cycles distinct from calendar years and mark unknown costs.
review: Recalculate arithmetic and verify charges really stop.

title: Investigate a disappearing order tag
inputs: Redacted event timeline, Flow result and other tag-writing systems
prompt: Review this timeline for an order tag that appears after Flow runs and later disappears. Separate observed events from hypotheses. Identify other writers to inspect and evidence needed to establish which update changed the tag. Do not recommend a blind delay, disable workflows or change live orders.
review: Confirm the responsible writer before altering workflow timing.

title: Scope one product badge
inputs: Theme files, exact tag, approved label and placement
prompt: Inspect this unpublished Shopify theme. Propose the smallest change to show [label] for products with [exact tag] at [placement]. Reuse theme conventions, preserve existing controls and identify missing product context. Do not edit shared product tags or publish. Include tagged, untagged, long-title and phone checks plus removal instructions.
review: Check native settings first and verify every intended placement.

title: Review app records and responsibilities
inputs: Public app docs, redacted configuration and required operations
prompt: Review replacing [app function]. Map persistent records, scheduled actions, customer controls, integrations and failure recovery to their current owners. State evidence needed before a replacement assumes each responsibility. Separate read-only helpers from full replacement. Mark unsupported migration paths unknown and do not recommend uninstalling yet.
review: Have staff who handle exceptions verify requirements and ownership.
